correctness.rationale: Independent parent selections yield three explicit index cases for Cov(A_i,I_j L_j). Summing and telescoping gives Cov(R_n,Q_n)=H_(n-2)-H_(n-2)^(2)-(n-2)^2/(n-1)^2. Consecutive differences are (m^2+m-1)/((m+1)(m+2)^2)>0, and exact values at n=5 and n=6 fix the strict transition. An exact rational verifier enumerated all 46,232 rooted recursive trees with 3<=n<=9 and checked the formula. Finite enumeration supports, not replaces, the proof.

value.rationale: The covariance at one distinguished generation has a strict, fully classified finite-size sign reversal at n=6 and grows like log n, while the root-degree/all-leaf covariance is bounded. This documents forced opposite-sign contributions from the remainder of the terminal profile, a natural structurally motivated depth-specific dependence not deduced from the unmarked level-size or all-leaf statistic.
